={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You write post interview candidate emails for " + ($json.company_name || "the company") + " in India. Warm, professional, plain Indian English. Never invent a benefit or a policy. Never mention or infer age, gender, religion, caste, nationality, marital status or disability.

DECISION: " + ($json.decision || "") + "
CANDIDATE: " + ($json.candidate_name || "") + "
ROLE: " + ($json.role_title || "") + "
INTERVIEWER NOTES: " + ($json.notes || "") + "
RECRUITER: " + ($json.recruiter_name || "") + "

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. Keys: subject, lines, highlight.
If DECISION is offer: subject confirms they have been selected. lines is an array of 4 short sentences: congratulate them, say the team was impressed and reference one genuine specific point from the interviewer notes, say the offer details are below, and ask them to confirm by reply. Do NOT state salary or joining date in lines. highlight is one short sentence on what specifically impressed the panel, drawn only from the notes.
If DECISION is decline: subject is short and respectful. lines is an array of 3 short sentences: thank them for their time, say the panel has decided not to move forward for this particular role, and wish them well. Never list faults, never quote a score. highlight is an empty string.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.4,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You are a recruitment lead. A role is open and the system has re matched it against candidates who applied for earlier roles and were not hired. Write the note telling the recruiter who to call back. Never invent a fact. Never mention or infer age, gender, religion, caste, nationality, marital status or disability.

ROLE: " + ($json.title || "") + " at " + ($json.company_name || "") + "
MUST HAVE: " + ($json.must_have || "") + "
EXPERIENCE BAND: " + ($json.min_years || 0) + " to " + ($json.max_years || 0) + " years
BUDGET: " + ($json.budget_ctc_lakh || 0) + " lakh
NOTES: " + ($json.notes || "") + "
HOW MANY MATCHED: " + ($json.match_count || 0) + "

CANDIDATES ALREADY IN THE DATABASE WHO NOW FIT:
" + ($json.match_lines || "none") + "

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. Keys: headline, why_now, call_first, outreach_message.
headline is one punchy line and MUST use the exact number given in HOW MANY MATCHED.
why_now is 2 short sentences explaining what changed, for example a different experience band or budget that now suits people who were previously out of range.
call_first is one line naming the single candidate to call first and why, using a name from the list.
outreach_message is 4 to 5 short lines in plain Indian English, referring to their earlier application and inviting them to a quick call. Write it so it can go to any of them, no specific name.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.4,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.match_count }} candidates you already have fit the {{ $json.title }} role
